r3_vs_r2_decision_diff: R3's CALIBRATION_PROBE_ONLY is a refinement of R2's NEED_MORE_DATA with a concrete next action: a $50 × 7d shadow probe with manual supervision and on-chain Swap event capture, to calibrate the R1/R2 fee proxy. R3 also documents the auto-exit wiring gap (P0) that R2 had not surfaced.
why_R3_matters: R3 closes the largest two unknowns from R1/R2: (1) the fee proxy is uncalibrated by direct on-chain evidence (the V3-fork storage layout mismatch makes it impossible to read feeGrowth in a canonical way), and (2) the auto-exit path is missing (no ticker, no loop, no watchdog calls OrderManager.Close on kill). Both are P0 blockers for autonomous GO_TINY_LIVE. R3's CALIBRATION_PROBE_ONLY is the cheapest path to ground-truth fee data via a manual shadow probe.
